_readme: Copy this file to config.json (same folder as server.py) and replace the values in angle brackets.
config.json is personal and must NEVER be published: it is already excluded by .gitignore.
Keys starting with _ are comments only: the server ignores them.
JSON does not allow a comma after the last element of a block: if the server does not start, check those first.
_phase: How much the server may do. 1 = read only (mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes): nothing is written, not even files. 2 = also saving mail and attachments to disk, read/unread flags, drafts, contacts, tasks, notes, folders, moves and deletion of mail to the trash. 3 = also create, update and delete calendar events. 4 = also send_alert. Advice: start at 1, move up as trust grows.
_timeout_seconds: Maximum wait for a single request to Outlook. When Outlook has a window open (password, warning) it does not answer: the server returns an explained error instead of hanging.
_max_body_chars: Maximum length of text (mail body, events, notes, tasks) returned to Claude in one read.
_mailboxes: Short alias -> store name EXACTLY as it appears in Outlook's folder pane (the bold name at the top of each account, e.g. 'john.smith@example.com' or 'John Smith'). Claude will use the aliases. List every account and data file (.pst) you want reachable; the ones not listed stay invisible to the server, even by exact name. install.ps1 prints the store names.

mailboxes.personal: <store name in Outlook, e.g. John Smith (Gmail)>

_default_mailbox: The alias (among those above) Claude uses when it does not name one.
_save_folders: The only disk folders the server may write files to (saved attachments, .msg mail). Subfolders included. Windows paths with doubled backslashes. At least one.
_attach_folders: The only folders create_draft may take attachments from (subfolders included). Absent or empty = drafts can have NO attachments. Use a folder DIFFERENT from save_folders: a mail read by Claude could otherwise try to get an archived message or a private file attached to a draft. Archived mail (.msg) and fingerprints (.sha256) are never attachable anyway.
_deletion_enabled: true = delete_mail and delete_event are active (they move to the trash, never delete permanently). false or absent = disabled.
_alert: Optional section, used only by send_alert (phase 4). 'sender' is the address of an account configured in Outlook; 'recipient' is the ONLY address the server will ever be able to write to (usually another address of yours, or the same one). 'subject_prefix' is prepended to the subject of every alert. 'max_per_hour' caps the alerts (default 10). Remove the section and send_alert always refuses.

alert.sender: <address of an account present in Outlook>

_courtesy_pauses: Every call into Outlook runs on its main thread: during a long read the Outlook window freezes. A pause of courtesy_pause_ms milliseconds every pause_every_items items lets Outlook breathe. 0 = no pause. Can be changed on the fly without a restart (re-read within 5 seconds).
